LB Semicon.why: A Korean OSAT that does wafer bumping, wafer-level packaging and test for non-memory chips (DDI, PMIC, CIS, AP; 97.27% of H1 2026 sales) and is developing hybrid-bump and 2.xD chiplet packaging for AI chips, so outsourced bumping / advanced-packaging volume drives its revenue.
LB Semicon.evidence: LB Semicon Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026) half-year report: it runs an OSAT business doing bumping, packaging and test for non-memory chips such as DDI, PMIC, CIS and smartphone AP, with semiconductor revenue KRW 271,496M (97.27%); its R&D includes an AI/HBM 2.5D package hybrid-bump process and an AI-semiconductor 2.xD chiplet package platform.

players.product: gold / Cu-pillar wafer bumping, WLCSP / FOWLP, COF packaging and test for DDI, PMIC, CIS and AP chips; 2.xD chiplet package platform for AI chips in development

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (consolidated): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 144,854,953,991 (Q2 2025: KRW 115,688,096,141) and operating profit KRW 13,108,569,883 (Q2 2025: operating loss KRW 3,306,404,461); H1 2026 revenue KRW 279,106,802,664 (H1 2025: KRW 232,500,539,184), operating profit KRW 20,751,800,153 (H1 2025: loss KRW 7,316,072,068) and net income KRW 19,388,839,330. FY2025 had an operating loss of KRW 39,800M
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue KRW 144,854,953,991; Q2 operating profit KRW 13,108,569,883; H1 revenue KRW 279,106,802,664

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 mix: semiconductor bumping, test and back-end services (DDI and others) KRW 271,496M (97.27%), battery-recycling black powder KRW 7,611M (2.73%); semiconductor service revenue domestic KRW 249,768M versus exports KRW 21,491M. Average bumping price KRW 292,682 per wafer (FY2025: KRW 193,281; FY2024: KRW 135,314) and COF KRW 247 per chip (FY2025: KRW 221). LB Lusem was merged into LB Semicon on 2025-02-01
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor KRW 271,496M (97.27%); bumping ASP KRW 292,682 per wafer

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 utilisation: bumping capacity 695,030 wafers, output 491,945, utilisation 70.78% (FY2025: 69.37%); COF capacity 368 Mpcs, output 272 Mpcs, utilisation 73.77%. H1 additions to machinery KRW 15,260M and construction in progress KRW 25,722M, described as capacity increases; idle Busan plant assets held for sale at KRW 5,674,516,840. Customers order roughly monthly with frequent add-on orders, so no order backlog is reported

Customer concentration (customers not named): Customer A KRW 105,105,204,701 (37.66% of revenue) and Customer B KRW 101,415,569,807 (36.34%) in H1 2026, versus 0.4270 and 0.3213 of revenue in H1 2025. The company says it keeps its DDI position with domestic panel makers and is pursuing customers in Taiwan, Japan and the US and with domestic and overseas fabless companies, including WLCSP customers

H1 2026 raw-material purchases KRW 226,507M: plating solutions KRW 140,969M (LT Metal, NMS and others), gold targets KRW 37,900M (Yuchang Metal and others), tape KRW 33,936M (LG Innotek, Stemco), battery scrap KRW 9,210M (LG Energy Solution); gold target cost KRW 166,080 per gram versus KRW 154,786 in FY2025
quarterly_data.figure: raw-material purchases KRW 226,507M; gold target KRW 166,080 per gram

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and AI packaging: it developed an AI/HBM 2.5D package high-precision hybrid-bump process (2024.02-2024.10) and from 2026.01 is developing an AI-semiconductor 2.xD chiplet package platform, a high-density multilayer thin FO-PoP platform and an embedded-passive FOCSP platform; H1 R&D spending KRW 1,363,050 thousand (0.49% of revenue). Company view: AI accelerator and HBM demand showed up in results in Q1 and again in Q2 2026, and demand for 2.5D / 3D packaging and chiplets kept rising through the half
